solution.key_idea: Clues 1 and 3 together leave Pablo only the Cortland apples, and clue 1's 15-pound gap puts him at 10 pounds.
steps: Clue 3 rules out Baldwin and Empire for Pablo, and clue 1 keeps him off Macoun. So Pablo picked the Cortland apples.
Clue 1's 15-pound gap fits only 10 and 25 pounds. So Pablo's Cortland apples weighed 10 pounds, and the Macoun apples 25.
Clue 4 keeps the Baldwin apples off 20 and 25 pounds, and 10 is taken, so they weighed 15. The Empire apples weighed 20.
Pablo picked 10 pounds, so by clue 2 Sam picked 20. Clue 5 then leaves Mabel only 25 pounds, and Kit picked 15.
Match the weights: Mabel picked the Macoun apples, Kit the Baldwin apples, and Sam the Empire apples.
solution.epilogue: The stand rang up Pablo's 10 pounds of Cortland, Kit's 15 of Baldwin, Sam's 20 of Empire and Mabel's 25 of Macoun. Mabel paid once the sign read "Fresh Apples."
